ns2:course.label: Materials Laboratory, I
ns2:course.description: (MATSE 207) Laboratory course to be taken simultaneously with or following MSE 401 and MSE 405. Experiments using optical and scanning electron microscopy and various thermal and thermodynamic measuring techniques. Introduction to use of laboratory test instruments. MSE 307 and MSE 308 are approved for General Education credit only as a sequence. Both courses must be completed to receive Advanced Composition credit. Prerequisite: Completion of campus Composition I requirement; credit or concurrent registration in MSE 401, MSE 405, and IE 300.
